post.description: OWNER. Receipt/return positive, correction signed nonzero delta, reconciliation absolute nonnegative physical count. Three decimals; maximum 999999999.999. Expected balance version prevents stale writes. Return references same-pair consumption and cannot cumulatively exceed it. No negative balances or counts below protected reservations. Same actor/key/payload replays once; changed operation/payload conflicts. All writes use company lock and transaction.

post.description: OWNER/DISPATCHER or assigned technician. Current job version and assignment binding; active IN_PROGRESS LEDGER visit only. Quantity cannot exceed allocation remaining. Atomically deducts on-hand/reserved, updates allocation/job version and records ledger/event/audit. Authorized same-key retry replays after closure. Observations and AI never consume stock. Assignment reserves REQUIRED parts atomically; closure/cancellation/rescheduling release unconsumed stock through Phase 5/6 APIs. LEDGER closure requires inventoryReviewed=true.
